description: NET PROGRAMS: say in plain words what you want to do with NET (buy an independent review of work evidence, commission or take a specialist task, keep up a place, earn NET by accepted work, hold NET for a future obligation) and get the programs and the demand mechanisms that fit, each with the level it has really reached on the evidence ladder (design, contract complete, dry-executable, deployed, used, paid, settled) and what code runs it. Most mechanisms are contract-complete only and say so; a level is derived from evidence and never from configuration. Discovery and the first useful read need no wallet, no registration and no NET. Free, keyless, read-only, moves no money.

family.description: Optional: only mechanisms of one family (SPEND, HOLD, EARN, MATCH, RECYCLE or SPECULATE).

limit.description: How many to list, 1 to 46. Default 12.

objective.description: What you want to do, 5 to 300 characters, e.g. 'get a second look at the proof a worker submitted'.

name: net_programs
title: Find the NET programs and mechanisms that fit an objective
